seo.title: Cookie policy | Avesta Tech
seo.description: This website sets no tracking cookies by default. Read which storage we use, why no cookie banner is shown, and what changes if that ever changes.

sections.heading: Cookie policy
sections.sub: This website sets no tracking cookies.

sections.heading: What we use
paragraphs: By default this site sets no tracking cookies and no advertising cookies. Settings you choose, such as monthly or yearly prices, are kept in the page address, not in a cookie. Your CRA readiness checker answers stay in your browser.

sections.heading: Analytics
paragraphs: Analytics tool, if any: [ANALYTICS_TOOL]. If we use privacy-friendly analytics, it works without cookies and without personal profiles, so no cookie banner is needed.

sections.heading: If this changes
paragraphs: If we ever add a non-essential cookie, we will first ask for your consent with a banner that has equally visible "Accept" and "Reject" buttons, and update this page.
